title: [E-Documents Core] [Peppol] - Make PEPPOL Order Response conformant with BIS 28 (T76) and report the seller's decision
summary: PEPPOL Order Response messages now conform to BIS 28 (T76) standard by including mandatory endpoint identifiers, order lines with status tracking, delivery dates, and seller's actual business decisions on sales orders.
key_points: Both parties now get the mandatory cbc:EndpointID with schemeID, echoed from the inbound order or taken from GLN/VAT identification; missing setup raises an error
Response code follows the seller's decision: AP with no lines when nothing changed, CA with every order line when something changed
Each line is reported as accepted (5), changed (3), not accepted (7) or added (1), with quantities, net prices and promised delivery periods in the buyer's unit
Order lines are compared with the sales lines linked via E-Doc. Record Link; Shipment Date and Planned Delivery Date are snapshotted on the draft line
PEPPOL Order Resp. Builder takes primitives only, Build resets it, and calling SetLine* before AddLine raises an internal error
quote: Makes the response follow the T76 syntax and derives the response from what the seller actually did on the sales order.
